en.title: The Jade Breath and the Specimen Box of Frozen Memories
en.premise: I am a 'Taxidermist of Memories,' one who transforms and preserves human memories as gemstones. I have spent my days crystallizing memories—those so beautiful they are precious, yet so sharp they tear the heart asunder—and locking them away in specimen boxes. Then, one winter day, a woman arrives with a nameless cat, stirring the frozen silence of my existence. This is a story of a world indulged in beautiful despair, slowly melting away under the impurity of warm tears.

zh.title: 翡翠的叹息与冰封记忆的标本盒
zh.premise: 我是将人们的记忆转化为宝石并予以保存的『记忆剥制师』。那些美到不愿失去、却又锐利到足以撕裂内心的记忆，我将其结晶化，封存在标本盒之中。直到某个冬日，一名带着无名之猫的女性出现，开始撼动我那冰封的静谧。这是一个沉溺于绝美绝望的世界，被名为『温暖泪水』的杂质逐渐融化的故事。
